subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.

Subir's long absence is likely to have _____ for employees in the office.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"repercussions"** refers to unintended consequences or effects, especially those with negative ramifications, that follow an event or action. (प्रभाव या प्रतिफल) • **Example:** The decision to cut down the forest had severe environmental **repercussions.** • The correct word,** "repercussions", fits the context of the sentence, indicating the outcomes or impacts that Subir's long absence might have on the employees in the office.** Therefore, the correct answer is: **repercussions**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Reprecussions** (प्रतिक्रिया): This is a misspelled version of the correct word "repercussions". • **Example:** Using "reprecussions" instead of "repercussions" is incorrect. • **Reprecurssions** (प्रतिक्रिया): This is another misspelled version of the correct word "repercussions". • **Example:** The word "reprecurssions" does not exist in the English language. • **Rapercussions** (प्रतिक्रिया): This is yet another misspelled version of the correct word "repercussions". • **Example:** "Rapercussions" is not the correct spelling of "repercussions". 1a2:Td3c,
